onb_1_title: WhatsApp pe lead ata hai. Phir bhool jate ho?
onb_1_sub: People DM you on Insta or WhatsApp, ask price, then their chat sinks to the bottom. Hum yaad rakhenge.
onb_2_title: Open the app. See exactly whom to ping today.
onb_2_sub: Ek hi list. Today, overdue, this week. No dashboards, no clutter.
onb_3_title: Tap to message. WhatsApp or Insta, ready to go.
onb_3_sub: App opens the chat with your message pre-typed. Offline-first. Aapka data sirf phone pe rahega.
today_catchup_banner: You missed {days} days of follow-ups — review now
empty_today_title: Chai pi lo, koi follow-up nahi.
empty_today_sub: No follow-ups due today. Add a new lead when someone DMs you next.
pro_card_today_body: You're using {used} / 50 on the free plan. Go Pro for unlimited leads, smart follow-up suggestions and CSV export.
field_interest_placeholder: e.g. Red velvet 1kg, eggless. Budget ₹1200. Wedding cake reference shared.
followup_template: Hi {firstName}! Following up on the {interest}. Still interested? 😊
empty_search_sub: Try a different filter or clear search.
pro_card_settings_body: Unlimited leads, advanced filters, CSV / JSON export and smart morning summary.
settings_default_delay_sub: When you add a new lead
settings_reminders_sub: Daily list of leads to follow up
settings_morning_summary_sub: "You have 5 leads to follow up today" when you open the app
settings_backup_export_sub: Save your leads as JSON / CSV
settings_footer: FollowUp Buddy v1.0 · made in India 🇮🇳 · Stored locally on this device
settings_seed_demo_sub: Demo data for screenshots — replaces your current leads
seed_confirm: This replaces all your current leads with 14 demo leads. Continue?
settings_clear_data_sub: Removes every lead, note and setting from this phone
clear_data_confirm: Delete all leads, notes and settings from this phone? This cannot be undone.
pro_renew_note: Auto-renews. Cancel any time in Google Play.
pro_unavailable: Pro is available in the Google Play version of FollowUp Buddy.
pro_active: Pro is active on this account. Thank you!
purchase_failed: Purchase did not complete. Please try again.
no_purchase_found: No active Pro subscription found for this Google account.
notify_mode_periodic: Daily reminder at this hour, even when the app is closed (installed from Google Play)
notify_mode_open: Reminder shows only while the app is open in this browser. Install from Google Play for a real daily alarm.
notify_permission_denied: Notifications are blocked — allow them in your phone settings
pipeline_hint: Leads move when you log an outcome: message sent → Contacted, Replied → Interested, Converted → Ordered.
stats_settings_sub: Monthly orders, best tags, best source
stats_empty: No orders yet. Mark a lead as Converted with its ₹ value and it shows here.
stats_footnote: Counted from the leads on this phone only. Order value = what you typed when marking Converted.
templates_settings_sub: {count} saved · a different opener per tag
templates_intro: Write up to 3 openers and attach one to a tag. When you tap WhatsApp or Instagram on a lead, the first tag with a template decides the message. You still send it yourself.
templates_limit_note: That is the maximum ({max}). Edit or delete one to add another.
templates_share_note: The "sent with FollowUp Buddy" line is always added at the end.
templates_delete_confirm: Delete this template? Tags using it go back to the default message.
snack_share_prefilled: Filled from what you shared — check and save
catalogue_settings_sub: {count} / {max} products · send a product card from any lead
catalogue_intro: Your best sellers with price and photo. From a lead, tap "Send product card" to make a shareable image + message.
catalogue_photo_hint: Resized to 800 px on your phone. Stays on this device.
catalogue_delete_confirm: Delete this product and its photo?
catalogue_privacy_note: Photos are stored only on this phone. They leave it only inside a card you share yourself.
card_send_sub: Pick a product → the app makes a 1080×1350 image + message. You share it yourself.
card_no_products: No products yet. Add a few in the Catalogue first.
snack_card_shared: Card handed to your share sheet
snack_card_downloaded: Card saved to downloads · message ready
cloud_settings_sub: Encrypted on this phone · restore on another phone
cloud_unavailable_body: The encrypted backup server is not switched on in this version. JSON backup in Backup & export works today.
cloud_intro: Your leads are encrypted on this phone with a passphrase only you know. The server stores scrambled data under a random vault code and cannot read it. Pro only, off until you create a vault.
cloud_passphrase_hint: At least 8 characters. If you forget it, nobody can recover the backup — not even us.
cloud_vault_code_hint: 32 characters, shown after you create the vault. Keep it with the passphrase.
cloud_auto_sync_sub: Uploads 30 s after a change while the app is open
cloud_forget_confirm: Remove the vault code and key from this phone? Your leads stay here; the cloud copy stays until you delete it from another phone.
cloud_delete_remote_confirm: Delete the encrypted copy from the server? Other phones using this vault will stop syncing.
cloud_conflict_confirm: The cloud copy is newer than this phone. Merge it into this phone now?
cloud_restore_confirm: Merge the cloud copy into this phone? Existing leads are kept; newer changes win.
cloud_key_note: The key made from your passphrase stays on this phone so sync can run without asking again.
snack_cloud_failed: Cloud sync failed — try again later
snack_cloud_too_large: Backup over 2 MB — remove some photos or leads
team_settings_sub: Share this list with one assistant through the vault
team_intro: One vault, two phones. Your assistant opens Cloud backup on their phone, taps "Restore / join", and enters your vault code + passphrase. Both phones then sync through the same encrypted vault; every note and message records which phone did it.
team_device_name_hint: Shown on history entries, e.g. "Anjali" or "Shop phone"
team_invite_body: Give them the vault code below and tell them the passphrase in person — never over chat. Anyone with both can read and edit this list.
team_no_vault: Create a vault in Cloud backup first.
team_merge_rule: When both phones change the same lead, the newer change wins; notes from both phones are kept.
self_digest_title: Send me today's list on WhatsApp
self_digest_sub: Opens a chat with your own number, list pre-typed. You tap Send.
self_digest_no_phone: Add your WhatsApp number in Profile first
profile_phone_hint: Only used for "Send me today's list". Never shared.
reactivate_body: {count} leads have been quiet for 30+ days. A festive hello often brings them back.
reactivate_confirm: Set a follow-up for tomorrow 9 AM on {count} quiet leads? You still message each one yourself.
